newsitem.title: USA: US spot jet diffs hover near steady in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: US spot jet diffs hover near steady in thin trade.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel differentials showed little movement Monday with few market players actively seeking barrels.
"We're not really back in the swing of things yet," one Gulf Coast trader said. "It was kind of a wasted day," he added.
US Gulf 54-grade jet fuel for back tenth cycle delivery on the Colonial Pipeline traded at 0.85 cents over the screen early in the day, though no other deals were confirmed.
Traders said New York Harbor prompt 54-grade jet was offered at 2.00 cents over, about steady with Thursday.
-- Matt Daily, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1620
